description: We are a team of 4 enthusiastic students participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. We are interested in space, science, technology, and innovation. Our goal is to explore new ideas, learn new skills, and develop creative solutions to real-world problems using NASA's open data.
summary:
EarthSound is an innovative, browser-based project that aims to make Earth science more accessible by converting visual Earth data into meaningful sounds in real time. We propose to develop an interactive platform that transforms patterns and changes in NASA Earth visualizations into audio signals using sound mapping techniques.

The system will translate data values into different sound properties, such as pitch, rhythm, and volume. For example, lower values will produce lower tones, while higher values will produce higher tones. Users will be able to listen to the sounds, control playback, adjust volume, and understand the data through a visual legend.

This project addresses the challenge of making complex Earth science information accessible to people with visual impairments and those who understand information better through audio. By combining visualizations with sound, EarthSound offers an alternative and engaging way to explore our planet.

Our goal is to make Earth science more inclusive, understandable, and accessible to everyone.
details:
EarthSound

EarthSound is an innovative, browser-based platform designed to make Earth science more accessible by transforming visual Earth data into meaningful sounds in real time.

How does it work?

The platform takes information from NASA Earth visualizations or supported datasets and converts changing data values into sound using a technique called sonification. Different values are represented through sound properties such as pitch, rhythm, and volume. For example, lower data values produce lower tones, while higher values produce higher tones. Users can listen to the generated sounds, control playback, adjust volume, and understand the information through a visual legend.

Benefits:

EarthSound provides an alternative way to explore Earth science, especially for people with visual impairments and individuals who understand information better through audio. It makes complex scientific information more engaging and easier to explore.

Intended Impact:

Our goal is to promote inclusive access to Earth science by allowing more people to experience and understand changes happening on our planet through both visual and auditory information.

Tools and Technologies:

The proposed technology stack includes HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Web Audio API, and optional Chart.js or SVG for visualization. NASA Earth Information Center (EIC) resources will provide the relevant Earth data and visualizations. GitHub will be used for project management and version control. Python may be used if additional data processing is required.

Creativity and Innovation:

The creative aspect of EarthSound is its ability to turn scientific data into an audio experience. Instead of relying only on traditional graphs and visualizations, it allows users to hear changes in Earth's systems through meaningful sound patterns.

Factors Considered:

We considered accessibility, scientific accuracy, data availability, ease of use, sound clarity, browser compatibility, and development time. We aim to ensure that the sounds accurately represent the selected data without creating misleading interpretations.
